Title: substring (
Description:
Returns a substring of string str. The start index is 1 based.
The substring is sublen characters long.
This function follows SQL 92.
substring('AbracadabrA',1,4) -> 'Abra'
substring('AbracadabrA',5,4) -> 'cada'
substring('AbracadabrA',8,4) -> 'abrA'
